concept: Inspector: continuous vulnerability scanning of EC2 and containers
tests: Which service automatically and continuously scans EC2 and container images for software vulnerabilities and network reachability.
expected: Amazon Inspector — automatic continuous scanning of EC2, ECR images (and Lambda) for CVEs and network reachability. Triggers: "software vulnerabilities", "container images", "unintended network exposure".
why_not: AWS Config — configuration compliance; GuardDuty — threat detection from logs and behavior; Trusted Advisor — general best-practice checks.
